# Explicit String Vacua and the Geometric Selection Conjecture, release 3.4.0

The paper by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya in its amsart form (57 pages), with its LaTeX source, the arXiv tarball and the checking programs. Contact for this repository: egspl@proton.me (GitHub account creelie).

- The note below the abstract is removed; the earlier versions are listed in the declarations at the end.
- New Section 16.6, "Filtrations that are not assumed equivariant". Lemma 16.24: χ(O_X(v)) is 2 modulo 4 exactly when v has one odd coordinate. Proposition 16.25(i): for the classes 2 and 7 the index of E ⊗ O(1,1,0,0), resp. E ⊗ O(1,0,1,0), is −22, not divisible by 4, so no vector bundle on X_π/Γ has their Chern character. Proposition 16.25(ii): for the fixed datum and the classes 6, 8, 10, H⁰(L_b L_a⁻¹) = 0 for a ≠ b, so every filtration of a Γ-bundle by their line bundles is Γ-stable. Corollary 16.26: C8_W fails for every bundle on X_π/Γ with three families whose pullback admits a filtration, Γ-stable or not, by the line bundles of one of the eleven data.
- The version DOI of release 3.3.0, 10.5281/zenodo.23788713, is recorded.
- `code/filtered_branch.py` now also checks Section 16.6 (7244 checks). The other programs are unchanged (511, 45, 61, 152 checks).
- The Geometric Selection Conjecture is not proved.

Assets: the PDF, the LaTeX source (tex.zip) and the arXiv tarball.
